mission: Deliver one validated NexusCentral application from one source tree, with desktop and web runtime profiles, local-owned user state, routing-only shared model capacity, internal application APIs, and evidence-gated harness execution.

acceptedEvidence.claim: The prerequisite goal-control domain is promoted and the selected ancestor path is dependency-complete at revision 3.

allowedReads: Git metadata and refs in this repository
Repository path names and status codes
exclusions: No checkout, switch, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, stash, reset, clean, fetch, pull, push, or worktree removal
No credentials, deployment, publication, or external submission
No reading or recording file contents outside matrix-control artifacts
acceptanceGate: Every pending path and status is recorded without mutation.
oneFixPlan: Capture every modified and untracked path with its exact Git status, branch, remote, and worktree context.
validationCommand: Compare a fresh porcelain-v2 status set and branch identity with the recorded snapshot.
cancellationRule: Stop before any Git or source mutation, on stale revision, or if status cannot be captured exactly.
